title: Axon invests $1.2B in Skydio, whose autonomous drones are used by public safety agencies, the US military, and 32 allied nations, at a $5.2B pre-money valuation (Carly Page/Resilience Media)
summary: Carly Page / Resilience Media: Axon invests $1.2B in Skydio, whose autonomous drones are used by public safety agencies, the US military, and 32 allied nations, at a $5.2B pre-money valuation — The investment gives Axon a minority stake in the US drone manufacturer and strengthens an exclusive public safety partnership …
